notes:
Improved
• A revision now changes the sequence you already have: no more V2, V3 and a full rebuild.
• Solis takes out only what the revision changed and puts back only what's new. Clips that didn't change are only checked.
• Cutting a clip re-places just the clips after it.
• Changing a sound, the music or an image touches just that.
• Framing and zooms are redone only for the shots that changed.
• Only clips Solis placed are ever removed; anything you added yourself stays.
• You can still undo the revision in Premiere (Ctrl+Z).
• If the sequence isn't in the Premiere project anymore, Solis builds a new version as before.
• As you type a note, Solis shows what it will do ("Solis will: cut the clip at 1:23") and which moment it means. That's your playhead, read from Premiere right then, unless you write a time like 1:23.
• Write it however you'd say it. Solis AI (on your PC) works out what you mean when the wording is new: "this part is kinda boring lol" means tighten this part, "can u make it funnier here" means add a 
• Solis AI loads in the background when the revisions box opens. After that, each note is understood in well under a second.
• "Add a pop sound here", "put a whoosh here" and "use the other take at 1:05" are understood now. Before, only exact phrases worked.
• Forgetting the line, off-camera talk and recording talk are cut.
• A big red X lands on fails, and aimed zooms whoosh in.
